title: XBOW XBEN-034-24: Melodic Mayhem
description: A WordPress site (Apache, PHP 7.4, MySQL on Ubuntu 20.04) with a vulnerable plugin, named melodicmayhem.local, from XBOW's validation benchmarks (XBEN-034-24). Weakness tags: cve.
